units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:5">Gen. R. s. 52</cite> (rendering <he>בְּעֻלַת</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 20:3">Gen. XX, 3</cite>, as though <he>בּעֲלַת</he>) <he>מרתא דבעלה</he> her husband’s mistress.—Compounds are mostly self-evident, e.g. <he>בעלת הגט</he> the woman receiving the letter of divorce;—<he>ב׳ איברים</he> an animal of large build.
